c176.name: Meteor
c176.lore: Meteor is not a soldier or a strategist. It is the sky itself choosing a target, a clean line of impossible mass that turns a crowded battlefield into an impact site.
c176.sig_desc: A burning descent that leaves no formation intact.
c176.playstyle: A reset button for crowded boards
c176.ability: Battlecry: Deal 4 damage to all other minions.

c177.name: Planetary Defense Grid
c177.lore: The Grid is a machine built around one promise: the world below gets another minute. Its guns do not seek glory; they turn every willing defender into part of a single planetary wall.
wk: Its aura is vulnerable to Silence
c177.sig_desc: Every defensive body shares one reinforced perimeter.
c177.playstyle: A fortress engine for Taunt formations
c177.ability: Taunt. Passive: All other Taunt minions have +2/+2.

rivals.rel: the impact it was built to stop

c178.name: Black Hole
c178.lore: Black Hole is a battlefield reduced to a single question: what can escape? It does not negotiate with buffs, shields, or proud names; once the horizon closes, every board becomes silence.
c178.sig_desc: A point of no return where every advantage loses its shape.
c178.ability: Deathrattle: Silence then destroy all minions.

rivals.rel: another answer to a full board

c179.name: Rudeus Greyrat
c179.lore: Rudeus Greyrat carries the memory of a life wasted and the discipline to refuse a second one. His body is small, his mana is not, and every quiet calculation becomes a spell with frightening reach.
str: Turns Hero Power timing into a resource
Divine Shield buys a crucial opening
wk: Fragile once the shield is gone
Needs a plan for direct pressure
Power is easy to waste on small targets
c179.sig_desc: A silent, compressed spell released before an opponent can read the casting.
c179.ability: Divine Shield. Passive: Your Hero Power costs 0.

rivals.rel: a fellow prodigy who refuses limits

c180.name: Prince Lloyd
c180.lore: Prince Lloyd approaches sorcery like a child approaches a locked box: with complete confidence that it will open. Curiosity makes him reckless, but the people near him discover that his experiments carry a protective radius.
c180.quote: Magic is all he ever wanted to perfect.
str: Makes a whole board harder to break
Divine Shield preserves his first turn
wk: Needs friendly minions to justify the cost
c180.sig_desc: A spell refined until its collateral damage becomes a defensive ward.
c180.playstyle: A protective aura around fragile threats
c180.ability: Divine Shield. Passive: Other friendly minions take 1 less damage.

rivals.rel: a shortcut he would happily dissect

c181.name: Motoko Kusanagi
c181.lore: Motoko Kusanagi treats identity as an operational question. A shell is equipment, a network is terrain, and the cleanest victory is the one where the hostile system wakes up serving your side.
c181.quote: The ghost can choose the shell.
c181.sig_desc: A precise intrusion that makes an enemy platform answer to a new operator.
c181.ability: Battlecry: Take control of an enemy Tech minion with 4 HP or less until the end of your next turn.

r001.name: The Holy Grail
r001.lore: The Grail does not make a bearer wiser. It makes the bearer larger than the battlefield expected, turning every ordinary measurement into a promise with dangerous scale.
wk: Needs a minion to carry it
Loses value when the bearer is removed
r001.sig_desc: A vessel that answers with mass instead of words.
r001.ability: The bearer doubles its ATK and HP.

r002.name: Lostvayne
r002.lore: Lostvayne is a weapon for the moment an enchantment expects to be the final word. Its edge is not louder than magic; it simply refuses to let magic decide the exchange.
str: Cheap enough to hold up a curve
r002.sig_desc: A reflected answer that makes hostile sorcery pay for arriving.
r002.playstyle: A matchup tool against Magic boards
r002.ability: The bearer is invulnerable to Magic attacks while defending.

rivals.rel: a bad matchup for a gifted caster

r003.name: One Ring
r003.lore: The One Ring is a bargain written in gold: survive the one moment that should end you, and pay for the rescue by giving the Ring away forever.
str: Creates a powerful threat of removal
r003.sig_desc: A vanished heartbeat becomes an entire second chance.
r003.ability: The first time the bearer would die, set it to full HP instead and destroy this relic.

rivals.rel: the rescue has to happen first

r005.name: Infinity Stone
r005.lore: An Infinity Stone turns one line of attack into a whole geometry. Distance stops protecting the formations beside the target; the adjacent battlefield becomes part of the equation.
wk: Does not improve the bearer directly
r005.sig_desc: One strike refracts into the spaces around its destination.
r005.ability: The bearer's attacks also strike the two minions adjacent to its target.

rivals.rel: sees the opening in the formation

r006.name: White Whistle
r006.lore: The White Whistle is permission to descend where ordinary rules fail. In Convergence, it teaches a single Battlecry not to end on arrival, but to keep sounding through the bearer.
str: Converts a burst into an engine
r006.sig_desc: One command repeats as an ongoing presence beneath the card.
r006.playstyle: Battlecry value that refuses to expire
r006.ability: The bearer's Battlecry effect turns into Ongoing effect.

r007.name: Chamber of Secrets
r007.lore: The Chamber is a secret that becomes a shelter. Its stone remembers an older magic, and living attacks find no purchase against a bearer who carries that locked door.
r007.sig_desc: An ancient threshold closes against the living world.
r007.ability: The bearer is invulnerable to Nature attacks while defending.

r008.name: Cyber-Enchantment
r008.lore: Cyber-Enchantment is the moment circuitry learns a spell. It wraps a bearer in a protocol no machine-born attack can complete, a quiet contradiction in the enemy's targeting logic.
r008.sig_desc: A closed loop that turns hostile hardware into harmless noise.
r008.ability: The bearer is invulnerable to Tech attacks while defending.

rivals.rel: the ghost looking for a way through
a different kind of locked door

r009.name: Ea
r009.lore: Ea does not sharpen a weapon; it argues with the shape of reality. In a bearer’s hands, an ordinary attack becomes twice as certain and twice as difficult to answer.
str: Turns small bodies into real clocks
wk: Needs a bearer that can attack
Can be wasted into a Taunt
r009.sig_desc: A rupture in the world that expresses itself as overwhelming attack.

r010.name: Elder wand
r010.lore: The Elder Wand's oldest trick is not greater damage. It is continuity: the bearer keeps its voice when a hostile hand tries to turn a living card into blank cardboard.
r010.sig_desc: A stubborn current of magic keeps the bearer from going quiet.
r010.ability: The bearer is immune to Silence.

rivals.rel: silence is part of the pull

r011.name: Monster Cell
r011.lore: A Monster Cell is a tiny decision with a large silhouette. The bearer gets stronger, but the new strength comes with the obligation to stand in front of everything that follows.
str: Adds Taunt at the same time
r011.sig_desc: A single cell turns a body into a barricade.

r012.name: Philosopher's Stone
r012.lore: The Philosopher's Stone changes the price of damage depending on who is paying. On your turn it is inviolable; on the enemy's turn, every hit lands with doubled consequence.
r012.sig_desc: The same wound means something different under different hands.
r012.playstyle: A timing relic for tempo turns
r012.ability: The bearer takes double damage on the enemy's turn but is invulnerable on your own.

r013.name: Allspark Cube
r013.lore: The Allspark refuses to let a defeated machine become waste. Every kill by its bearer is a recovery operation, a hostile body converted into a future draw.
wk: Needs the bearer to secure kills
Hand space can become a limit
r013.sig_desc: A fallen enemy leaves behind a usable blueprint.
r013.playstyle: A cheap value relic for trading minions
r013.ability: When the bearer kills an enemy minion, take that minion as a card to your hand.

r014.name: Anti-magic Mask
r014.origin: That time I got reincarnated as a Slime
r014.lore: The Anti-magic Mask is a blank expression worn against the Rift's two favorite interruptions. Freeze cannot hold it, and chains cannot decide where its bearer belongs.
r014.sig_desc: A surface with nothing for hostile status magic to grip.
r014.ability: The bearer is immune to Freeze and Chained.

r015.name: Devil Fruit
r015.epithet: A Taste of the Sea's Secret
r015.lore: The Devil Fruit is a permanent appetite. Once tasted, it keeps rewriting the bearer upward, trading ordinary comfort for a power that never stops asking for another turn.
wk: The bearer cannot swim away from trouble
r015.sig_desc: An impossible power becomes ordinary through repetition.
r015.ability: The bearer gains an additional Ongoing: gain +2/+1.

r016.name: Healing Potion
r016.origin: That time I got reincarnated as a Slime
r016.lore: The Healing Potion is a tiny reset button. It cannot make a bearer stronger, but it can make the damage already paid disappear before the opponent gets to count it.
wk: Does not prevent the next hit
r016.sig_desc: The last wound is erased in a single swallow.
r016.playstyle: Cheap sustain for a key bearer
r016.ability: The bearer is fully healed the moment it is equipped.

r017.name: Queen's Cocoon
r017.lore: Queen's Cocoon turns a bearer into a promise the opponent can see but cannot rush. The silence lasts one turn; the awakening comes back with three new reasons to be afraid.
r017.sig_desc: Stillness is the first phase of a much larger body.
r017.ability: The bearer is Chained for a turn. When it awakens, it gains +3/+3.

r018.name: Shinigami Eyes
r018.lore: Shinigami Eyes make defenses legible. Taunt is only a sign, Divine Shield only a layer, and the bearer has already read the name beneath both.
r018.sig_desc: The battlefield's protections become annotations rather than walls.
r018.playstyle: A surgical answer to defended targets
r018.ability: The bearer ignores Taunt and Divine Shield.

rivals.rel: sees the gap in the wall

r019.name: The Green Mask
r019.lore: The Green Mask treats death as a punchline with a delayed reveal. When its bearer falls, the joke is not over; the card returns to hand, ready to find a new face.
wk: The opponent still gains the trade
r019.sig_desc: The fall is only an exit cue, not a final scene.
r019.ability: Return the bearer to your hand after death.

rivals.rel: one body returns, another is salvaged

r020.name: Tesseract
r020.lore: The Tesseract folds distance into opportunity. A bearer that already attacked can simply arrive at the same decision again, making one body occupy twice the turn it was given.
wk: Needs a bearer with a legal target
r020.sig_desc: The interval between attacks collapses to nothing.
r020.ability: The bearer can attack twice each turn.

rivals.rel: two fragments of one cosmic language

r021.name: Infinity Castle
r021.lore: Infinity Castle makes the battlefield forget where its corridors were. Half of all attacks find an empty room, and the bearer survives by never being exactly where the blow expects.
r021.sig_desc: An attacker takes one route while the bearer is already elsewhere.

rivals.rel: a natural home for the Major

r022.name: Pandora's Box
r022.lore: Pandora's Box is a promise made in two halves. First it makes the bearer larger; later, when the lid finally opens, it forces the opponent to accept whatever the deck sends them.
str: Summons a random enemy body on death
r022.sig_desc: Every answer creates the next problem.
r022.ability: The bearer gains +4/+4. When it dies, your opponent summons a random minion from the deck.

rivals.rel: the box wants a different ending

r023.name: The Monkey's Paw
r023.lore: The Monkey's Paw grants exactly what was asked for and schedules the invoice. The bearer becomes enormous now, but next turn the wish collects its price without appeal.
r023.quote: Be careful what you wish for.
wk: Easy for the opponent to time around
r023.sig_desc: Power arrives early because the consequence is already on its way.
r023.ability: The bearer gains +5/+5. It dies next turn.

rivals.rel: a wish without the fine print

r024.name: Ark of the Covenant
r024.lore: The Ark carries an authority that does not need to attack. Its bearer gets one perfect layer of protection, a sacred refusal to let the first answer land.
r024.sig_desc: A sealed presence makes the first hit feel like sacrilege.
r024.playstyle: Straightforward protection for a premium minion

r025.name: Necronomicon
r025.lore: The Necronomicon does not summon the dead from nowhere; it makes their last act refuse to finish. Every Deathrattle reads twice when the book is open beside its bearer.
wk: The opponent can remove the bearer
r025.sig_desc: The same final sentence is spoken once more from the dark.
r025.playstyle: A combo relic for death-trigger decks

rivals.rel: the book wants survivors of the silence
two ways to make text persist

r026.name: Dragon Balls
r026.lore: The Dragon Balls ask for patience and pay it back with a legend. When the bearer falls, the wish is finally assembled and Shenron arrives to turn absence into a new body.
wk: The payoff is delayed and specific
r026.sig_desc: Seven small lights become one impossible answer.
r026.ability: Summon Shenron after the bearer dies.

r027.name: Mjolnir
r027.lore: Mjolnir recognizes no résumé, only worthiness. A Good bearer carrying it can attack without fear, entering combat as thunder rather than as a target waiting to be traded.
str: Turns a Good finisher into a safe clock
r027.sig_desc: The hammer answers an attack with absolute confidence.
r027.playstyle: A safe offensive relic for Good threats
r027.ability: Can only be equipped by Good minions. The bearer is Invulnerable while attacking.

r028.name: Excalibur
r028.lore: Excalibur is a decision made visible. A Good bearer draws it and does not wait for permission from the next turn; the sword makes readiness part of the equipment.
r028.quote: The right hand finds the hilt.
wk: A small bearer can still trade down
r028.sig_desc: The moment the blade clears the stone, the turn has already begun.
r028.ability: Can only be equipped by Good minions. The bearer gains Charge.
